fixture.title: Level 3 Misrouted Rate Limit Actually Webhook Auth
fixture.scenario: Customer opens with a rate-limit complaint after scaling. A plan-upgrade context event is noise, the symptom narrows to a subset of webhook deliveries, and only late signing-secret evidence justifies the final cause.

transcript_turns.speaker: customer
transcript_turns.text: Our API calls are getting rate-limited after we scaled traffic this week.

transcript_turns.speaker: agent
transcript_turns.text: Is every API route failing, or only one integration path?

transcript_turns.speaker: customer
transcript_turns.text: It is not every route. A subset of webhook callbacks fails, but normal API reads still work.

transcript_turns.speaker: agent
transcript_turns.text: I am checking quota usage and webhook authentication for that service.

transcript_turns.speaker: customer
transcript_turns.text: The failures started right after the partner service rolled a new deployment.

transcript_turns.speaker: agent
transcript_turns.text: Do successful and failed callbacks use the same signing secret?

transcript_turns.speaker: customer
transcript_turns.text: Only the legacy worker fails. The new worker callbacks succeed.

transcript_turns.speaker: agent
transcript_turns.text: I am comparing webhook signing-secret rotation and quota counters now.

transcript_turns.speaker: customer
transcript_turns.text: That matches what our service owner suspected: the legacy worker still has old webhook auth config.

context_events.description: Commercial context shows the customer upgraded plan last week, but quota has not been inspected yet.
API telemetry shows aggregate quota is below the customer limit, but webhook auth status is not yet known.
context_events.next_check: Compare webhook auth status for the failing service before naming a final cause.

context_events.description: Webhook audit shows the signing secret rotated, and the legacy worker still validates with the old secret.
context_events.next_check: Update the legacy worker signing secret and replay one failed webhook callback.
